tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: Your spring-break hotel booking confirmation contains errors, and you need the hotel manager to correct them. Write an email to Ms. Johnson.
bullets: Explain what the inaccuracies in the booking details are.
Request confirmation of the corrected booking.
Ask about additional hotel amenities and offers.
tasks.subject: Correction needed for hotel booking
